items.title: This Is the Worst Stock In the S&P 500 Today
items.summary: On Tuesday, the provider of software and hardware for automotive safety and self-driving applications reported second-quarter earnings per share of $1.63 from sales of $3.3 billion.  For the third quarter, Aptiv seeks earnings per share of about $1.30.  The stock lost 16.6%, closing at $47.72 and taking the title of worst in the S&P 500 for the day, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
